data.financial_summary: Based on a monthly income of ₹90,000 and existing debt of ₹12,000 (DTI: 13.3%), your financial profile shows resilient borrowing capacity. Reviewing repayment tenure and existing commitments is advised prior to formal application.
key_strengths: Strong credit score of 750, placing you in prime borrowing territory.
Healthy current Debt-to-Income ratio (13.3%), leaving capacity for strategic leverage.
Commendable cash flow surplus of ~53.3% after expenses and debt servicing.
areas_needing_attention: Maintaining vigilance on recurring discretionary expenditures.
practical_suggestions: Establish an emergency fund equivalent to 6 months of mandatory living expenses before taking new credit.
Maintain credit card utilization strictly under 30% on each billing cycle to protect your score.
Compare interest offers (fixed vs. floating) and inquire about prepayment penalty waivers.
Avoid making multiple simultaneous loan applications to prevent inquiry clustering.
questions_before_borrowing: How secure is your primary income source over the proposed loan tenure?
Will your monthly budget remain resilient if inflation or unexpected healthcare costs increase?
Could you accelerate repayment through bonuses or annual tax refunds?
Have you accounted for ancillary costs like processing fees, stamp duty, and loan insurance?
